environment.memoryMeaning: Heap and renderer counters are not physical GPU memory measurements.

method: 240 browser-RAF-paced synthetic pointermoves per condition after a native pointerdown; first completed main submission per step. Missing steps are failures. Intervals measure render submission cadence, not GPU execution time or independent presentation timestamps. Driver transport idle gaps are excluded by input construction, not by filtering slow samples.
